card.name: Words leading into a time before an event
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces right after a verb or a dose, where a time phrase about before or ahead of an event is about to follow, such as "at least", "within", or "immediately" before use.

modes.label: Pre-treatment timing
modes.description: Linking word or space before a number of minutes or hours ahead of an infusion or chemotherapy.
modes.example: premedicate with a corticosteroid, antihistamine, and an antipyretic<< at>> least 30 to 60

modes.label: Time or date slot
modes.description: A blank space before a clock time or date number.

modes.label: Before an event in general text
modes.description: A word in ordinary text that sets up when something happens relative to a game, show or race.
modes.example: he reread the book before rehearsals started<< last>> season “to refresh my memory.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about preparing or preparation, as in getting ready before an event.
card.plain: It notices spots where the text is about to say how long before something an action should happen.
